ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which letter completes the word _ُور to make nuur (light)? (1 mark)
   A. ن (nuun)
   B. ي (yaa)
   C. ت (taa)
   D. ب (baa)

2. What is the name of the Arabic letter ر? (1 mark)
   A. raa
   B. baa
   C. nuun
   D. yaa

3. What is the ending of the letter ة in جَدَّةٌ called? (1 mark)
   A. taa marbuta
   B. shadda
   C. hamza
   D. sukuun

4. What does the Arabic word ابْنٌ (ibn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. brother
   B. grandmother
   C. sister
   D. son

5. What does the Arabic word نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) mean? (1 mark)
   A. knife
   B. bathroom
   C. door
   D. window

6. What does the Arabic sentence النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The door is big.
   B. The chair is new.
   C. The window is clean.
   D. The table is small.

7. Which Arabic word means "room"? (1 mark)
   A. غُرْفَةٌ
   B. قَلَمٌ
   C. نَافِذَةٌ
   D. كُوبٌ

8. Which day ends with taa marbuta (ة)? (1 mark)
   A. as-sabt
   B. al-khamiis
   C. al-ahad
   D. al-jumuʿa

9. What does the Arabic word الثُّلَاثَاءُ (ath-thulaathaa') mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Wednesday
   C. Monday
   D. Thursday

10. Which Arabic word means "congratulations"? (1 mark)
   A. رَقْصٌ
   B. مَبْرُوكٌ
   C. حَلْوَى
   D. عِيدٌ

11. Which style is quick and simple and used for everyday handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Thuluth
   B. Diwani
   C. Ruqʿah
   D. Kufic

12. What does the Arabic sentence الْأَصْدِقَاءُ يَأْكُلُونَ الْكَعْكَةَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My mother cooks the food.
   B. I have a gift.
   C. The friends eat the cake.
   D. I like the party.

13. Which Arabic sentence means "I eat rice." (1 mark)
   A. أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ
   B. الْمَوْزُ لَذِيذٌ
   C. رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ
   D. آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ

14. What does shaping of characters mean? (1 mark)
   A. Drawing pictures
   B. Writing very fast
   C. Using many colours
   D. Writing each letter in its correct shape

15. Which Arabic word means "finger"? (1 mark)
   A. كَتِفٌ
   B. قَلْبٌ
   C. إِصْبَعٌ
   D. وَجْهٌ

16. Which describing word matches yad (hand), which is feminine? (1 mark)
   A. jadiid
   B. Sagiira
   C. kabiir
   D. qawiyy

17. What does the Arabic sentence الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind is strong.
   B. The sun is hot.
   C. This is the sun.
   D. This is rain.

18. What does the Arabic word بِيئَةٌ (bii'a) mean? (1 mark)
   A. sun
   B. tree
   C. sky
   D. environment

19. Which Arabic word means "beside"? (1 mark)
   A. بِجَانِبِ
   B. أُمٌّ
   C. قَوِيٌّ
   D. رِجْلٌ

20. What does it mean if a paragraph is coherent? (1 mark)
   A. It is written in colour
   B. Its sentences fit together and make sense
   C. It has only one word
   D. It is very long

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: yadii Sagiira (2 marks)

22. Write a three-sentence paragraph about your room in Arabic sounds and give the meaning. (5 marks) (5 marks)

23. Write three body parts in Arabic sounds with meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

24. Describe three steps of making a weather poster. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Describe how to make a food chart for the class wall. (3 marks) (3 marks)

26. Translate into English: al-kursiyyu jadiid (2 marks)

27. Translate into English: anaa uhibbu l-hafla (2 marks)

28. Spell the word الخميس by naming its letters in order. (3 marks) (3 marks)

29. Give three qualities of neat and legible writing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

30. Write one Arabic sentence about your body in sounds and translate it. (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Put these letters in order to make a day: ت ب س. Write the word and its meaning. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #3 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — ن (nuun)
   The word nuur (نُور) starts with nuun.

2. A — raa
   The letter ر is called raa.

3. A — taa marbuta
   ة is taa marbuta and appears at the end of many feminine words.

4. D — son
   ابْنٌ (ibn) means son.

5. D — window
   نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) means window.

6. C — The window is clean.
   النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ (an-naafidhatu nadhiifa) means: The window is clean.

7. A — غُرْفَةٌ
   غُرْفَةٌ (ghurfa) means room.

8. D — al-jumuʿa
   الجمعة ends with ة.

9. A — Tuesday
   الثُّلَاثَاءُ (ath-thulaathaa') means Tuesday.

10. B — مَبْرُوكٌ
   مَبْرُوكٌ (mabruuk) means congratulations.

11. C — Ruqʿah
   Ruqʿah is a short, quick style used in notes and everyday writing.

12. C — The friends eat the cake.
   الْأَصْدِقَاءُ يَأْكُلُونَ الْكَعْكَةَ (al-asdiqaa'u ya'kuluuna l-kaʿka) means: The friends eat the cake.

13. D — آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ
   آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ (aakulu l-aruzza) means: I eat rice.

14. D — Writing each letter in its correct shape
   Each letter must have its known shape so the reader can read it.

15. C — إِصْبَعٌ
   إِصْبَعٌ (isbaʿ) means finger.

16. B — Sagiira
   yad is feminine, so it takes the describing word ending in -a.

17. A — The wind is strong.
   الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

18. D — environment
   بِيئَةٌ (bii'a) means environment.

19. A — بِجَانِبِ
   بِجَانِبِ (bijaanibi) means beside.

20. B — Its sentences fit together and make sense
   A coherent paragraph has related sentences in a sensible order.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: My hand is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example: haadhihi ghurfatii. fii l-ghurfati sariir. uhibbu ghurfatii. This is my room. In the room there is a bed. I like my room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence, 1 mark for a beginning-middle-end order and 1 mark for the meaning.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example raʾs (head), yad (hand), fam (mouth).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Draw and colour the sun, clouds, rain and wind; write the Arabic word under each; add a sentence and a title and display it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Draw local foods, write the Arabic name under each picture, colour it and post it on the wall for review.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for drawing, 1 mark for labels and 1 mark for posting or review.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: The chair is new.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: alif, laam, khaa, miim, yaa, siin.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all six letters in order; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Letters of the correct shape and same size; letters on the baseline; correct dots and marks; small spaces between words.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example aktubu bi-yadii. I write with my hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: سبت (sabt), Saturday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the meaning.
